messages.old: Gantt: Owen Pritchard. Mercy's sheriff. Green cabin above the road. He'll want what you actually saw, not what somebody talked you into believing.
messages.new: Gantt: Owen Pritchard. Mercy's sheriff. Green cabin above the road. Give him a plain account. He'll have enough guesses without ours.

messages.old: Pritchard: Thank you for bringing the dispatch. I need facts before I tell Mercy what happened. Ask Ada Pike when the railway last bought brake shoes, then bring me her account.
messages.new: Pritchard: Thank you for bringing the dispatch. I need a fact I can check. Ask Ada Pike when the railway last bought brake shoes, then bring me her account.

messages.old: Pritchard: Tobias is dead. I'm sorry to hear it. I need facts before I tell Mercy what happened. Ask Ada Pike when the railway last bought brake shoes, then bring me her account.
messages.new: Pritchard: Tobias. Damn. You brought his dispatch through. Thank you. Ada Pike keeps the railway's repair books. Ask when they last bought brake shoes, then bring me her account.

messages.old: Pritchard: I'll check the railway's records against her account. When you're ready, we can talk about the roads out of Mercy.
messages.new: Pritchard: I'll check the railway's records against her account. You've done what I asked. Take a minute before you choose another road.
